free_tier.stated: A free plan per model, printed as RPM / RPD / TPM / TPD: openai/gpt-oss-120b and openai/gpt-oss-20b at 30 requests a minute, 1,000 a day, 8,000 tokens a minute and 200,000 tokens a day, which works out to 6.0M tokens a month per model. Paid Developer rates for the same model are USD 0.15 per 1M input and USD 0.60 per 1M output at 1,000 RPM and 250K TPM.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: the daily pool is small but the latency is the point: 500 tokens a second on this model spends the 200K-token day in about 7 minutes of generation, so Groq is the cheap first pass and Cloudflare or DeepSeek takes the volume.

limits.value: the 8,000 tokens a minute binds before the 200,000 a day: at 8K TPM the day's whole allowance is reachable in 25 minutes of continuous traffic, so the pool is spent by mid-morning and the rest of the day is idle unless the job is paced.

record.limits_note: the 8,000 tokens a minute binds before the 200,000 a day: at 8K TPM the day's whole allowance is reachable in 25 minutes of continuous traffic, so the pool is spent by mid-morning and the rest of the day is idle unless the job is paced.

identity_cost.detail: one form, Create Account or Login, serves both sign-up and login with Google, GitHub, SSO and email; the served auth config lists only OAuth (Google, GitHub), SSO and email magic links, so the email route is a magic link and there is no password and no SMS method. The sign-up request carries only the session token and an optional referral code, with a Stytch device telemetry ID header: no phone number and no card. A payment method (credit card, US bank account or SEPA debit account) is required only to upgrade from the Free tier to the Developer tier. Creating an API key requires a Cloudflare Turnstile token.

record.notes: Arithmetic, labelled estimate: 200,000 tokens a day is 6.0M a month per model, and about 24M a month across the four free text models if every model is used. At the Developer rate that 6.0M is worth roughly USD 0.90 to USD 3.60 a month depending on the input/output split. GPU-equivalent, labelled estimate: 6.0M output tokens a month at 500 tokens a second is about 3.3 hours of continuous single-stream generation a month. Confirms earlier readings record (inference/groq): the numbers are unchanged on 2026-10-22. Adds the capacity shape, which that record does not carry.
